name: Runemaster Speed Rune stealths allies only with Elemental Secrets (#3111, #5616)
contract: Elemental Secrets 707149 reads 'Increases the cooldown of Speed Rune by $/1000;s1 sec, but it now applies stealth
to allies who walk on the pathway for the duration.' Its only effect is a flat +30000 ms cooldown modifier on
Speed Rune 801103 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x2000000). The stealth itself is in the Speed Rune path 572136: effect 0
periodically triggers the speed aura 802725 and effect 1 periodically (250 ms) triggers Elemental Secrets 706736
(SPELL_AURA_MOD_STEALTH, tooltip 'Stealthed.') on every ally in the path, with no caster requirement. So every
Speed Rune stealthed its allies, talent or not (#5616). Expected: without the talent the ally in the path gets
the speed aura but no stealth; with the talent the ally gets both and Speed Rune's cooldown is 150 s. Fails
before the fix (the untalented path stealths the ally); passes after.

steps.label: SETUP: ally inside the untalented path gains the speed aura
Let several 250 ms path ticks pass
CONTRACT: the untalented path does not stealth the ally
Untalented Speed Rune keeps its 120 s cooldown
Let the untalented path and its lingering auras expire
SETUP: ally inside the talented path gains the speed aura
CONTRACT: the Elemental Secrets path stealths the ally
CONTRACT: Elemental Secrets adds 30 s to Speed Rune's cooldown
